title: Seasonal Wardrobe Readiness
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=wardrobe:item OR sourcetype=ecowitt:obs)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(outdoor_temp_c) as temp, sum(eval(if(season="winter" AND status="stored",1,0))) as stored_winter by _time
| where temp<8 AND stored_winter>0
| sort - _time
description: Reminds you to swap seasonal clothes out of storage when the weather turns, so you are never caught cold.
value: Matching your wardrobe to the forecast means the warm coat is out before the first frost, not after.
implementation: Join wardrobe status with weather in `index=personal`; alert when stored seasonal wear is needed.
visualization: Table flagging seasonal wardrobe swaps due.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds you to get seasonal clothes out of storage when the weather turns, so you are ready.
